item.name: The Copilot question: Platinum, P1, open 48h+, renewal within 90 days

exec: pm.test('exactly the three expected cases', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(c => c.id).sort()).to.eql(['CS-10231','CS-10232','CS-10233']));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('5 items and a cursor', () => { pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.page.nextCursor).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Receiver got a signed, verified case.escalated event

exec: setTimeout(function () {}, 2500);  // let the dispatcher tick (it polls every second)
const ev = pm.response.json(); pm.test('event delivered', () => pm.expect(ev.some(e => e.type === 'case.escalated' && e.caseId === 'CS-10237' && e.signatureVerified === true)).to.eql(true));

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('degraded with usage missing', () => { pm.expect(j.degraded).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.degradedSources).to.include('usage'); pm.expect(j.usage).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Globex Systems'); });
